blocks.text: The Internet & SaaS Device Management page displays all the Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) devices in your organization that have Zscaler Client Connector for VDI deployed. You can select these VDI devices when configuring security policies​​​​​.
The VDI Devices page provides the following benefits and enables you to:

blocks.item: View the VDI devices with Zscaler Client Connector for VDI installed.
Assess the VDI device status and details.

blocks.text: On the VDI Devices page (Administration > Internet & SaaS Authentication > Internet & SaaS Device Management > VDI Devices), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Select a search parameter from the drop-down menu (e.g., Device Hostname).
Modify the table and its columns.
View a list of all VDI devices. For each VDI device, you can view the following information:
Device ID: The ID of the VDI device.
Device Name: The name of the VDI device.
Device Hostname: The hostname of the VDI device. This field displays values only if you have configured Zscaler Client Connector to collect the hostname information.
OS Type: The OS type of the VDI device.
OS Version: The OS version of the VDI device.
Device Model: The model of the VDI device.
Device Owner: The owner of the VDI device.
Description: The description of the VDI device.
View more information about the VDI device.
Go to the Devices and Device Groups pages.
Go to the VDI Device Groups page.
